name: Diamond Lake and Rocky Mountain
why: A short climb past a small lake and up bluffs to a 775 m summit with Lake Wānaka and Mount Aspiring in view.
book: Free, no permit. Car park 18.5 km west of Wānaka on the Wanaka-Mt Aspiring Road (sealed); toilet there, none on the track.
water: None on the track: carry 1 litre.
dangers: Steep and slippery sections, light scrambling on the western side.
Steep drop-offs on the eastern side.
Ice in winter: the Diamond Lake track may not be safe.
turnaround: In ice or after heavy rain, stop at the Diamond Lake platform and go back.

points.name: Diamond Lake car park
points.note: An old dirt road climbs to the lake.

points.name: Diamond Lake platform
points.note: Viewing platform on the bluffs above the small lake, where the circuit tracks start.

points.name: Rocky Mountain summit
points.note: 775 m: Lake Wānaka, the Southern Alps and Mount Aspiring/Tititea. Up the western side, down the eastern side.
